BL-1490 — handoffd supervisor kills a PROGRESSING daemon again: the per-tick phases BL-977 never covered - outbox delivery (poll-once!) and startup-notify - publish no progress, so a burst of four or five coordinator notes delivered at ~9 s each outruns the 30 s stall window with the sweep marker reading idle and alarm-and-halt kills every role session; 7 full-swarm kills in ten hours on 2026-09-07/08 and 65 of the 150 halts on record; every poll-cycle phase publishes its progress and :stalled requires true silence across the WHOLE cycle
What it solves: - Minted 2026-09-08 by the specifier, splitting the intake 1:N
  (Consolidation Authority): BL-1490 the verdict, BL-1491 the silence,
  BL-1492 the blast radius; BL-1493/BL-1494 found underneath. Grepped
  first: BL-977 (done) covers run-sweep! sweeps only; BL-1342 (done)
  covers daemon age <= 30 …
Approval context: A new feature file is authored here, so it needs a tap. No choice is posed and there are no ruling_options. FIRM, restat…
BL-1490 needs your approval before it can proceed. Reply here with "approve BL-1490" (or "reject BL-1490 <reason>") to act.
